name: Fogveil Studded Leather
summary: Studded leather that lets you wrap yourself in a bank of fog.
description: Smugglers on the foggy coast pay a king's ransom for it. The studs are tiny silver pearls.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. As a Magic action, you can cast *Fog Cloud* from it, centered on yourself. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.
